factor.name: declared_coefficient_activity_rollout_count_N
factor.interpretation: Within each N, the Frontier-minus-MaxMC contrast isolates score choice conditional on that shared layout. Across N, n_eval, n_parallel, and buffer_size change jointly with declared Frontier N.
factor.identifiability_limit: Neither the cross-N cell means nor contrast-of-contrasts isolate estimator N alone; they estimate effect modification by the joint N/n_eval/n_parallel/buffer-size layout factor.

future_hashed_driver_must_set_and_verify: run_id unique over N, arm, seed, and attempt
xpid equal to the campaign-bound run identity

exact_63_cycle_label_requires: every one of the first 63 fill cycles accepts exactly n_parallel distinct new groups
no incomplete or nonfinite rejected groups
filled-count trajectory matches the per-layout formula
receipt_gate.if_gate_fails: report observed replay-eligibility cycle and exact observed cumulative transitions; never label the warm fill as 63 cycles or 516096 transitions

must_equal_exactly: the complete set of aligned fixed-transition cycle observations
within_N_seed_pair_validity_gate.failure_policy: invalidate the entire N/seed pair; do not impute, trim, or report its score contrast

fixed_update_primary.across_N_interpretation: fixed-update contrast-of-contrasts are layout-conditioned differences of within-layout score contrasts; they are not pure estimator-N effects or equal-transition comparisons
fixed_update_primary.interpretation: a terminal Frontier-minus-MaxMC score contrast is valid only when its within-N/seed pair has exactly equal n_updates, upstream n_grad_updates, optimizer applications, outer cycles, and training transitions

fixed_transition_secondary.grid_is_guaranteed_preterminal: robust PLR performs at most one student PPO update per outer cycle and cannot replay before at least 63 fill cycles, so 30000 updates require at least 30063 outer cycles
fixed_transition_secondary.checkpoint_or_evaluation_policy: use only measurements emitted at the exact cycle boundary; no interpolation or last-observation carry-forward
fixed_transition_secondary.alignment_gate: for every N/seed pair, both arms must contain exactly one valid observation at every declared cycle and transition boundary; otherwise invalidate the pair
fixed_transition_secondary.across_N_alignment: all six cells use the same declared cycle/transition grid, so fixed-transition contrast-of-contrasts are transition-aligned but still estimate the joint layout factor rather than estimator N alone
fixed_transition_secondary.interpretation: transition-indexed results are secondary learning-efficiency descriptions and do not replace the fixed-update primary contrast

terminal_checkpoint_contract.save_timing: save a new terminal checkpoint only after the loop has reached exactly 30000 student PPO updates and all terminal counters have been read
terminal_checkpoint_contract.periodic_checkpoint_role: diagnostic artifact only; it cannot supply a terminal or analysis endpoint and cannot be used for recovery or resume in this campaign without an outcome-blind protocol amendment and new campaign identity
round_trip_must_bind_exactly: campaign ID, cell ID, run ID, xpid, arm, N, n_eval, n_parallel, buffer_size, and seed
terminal checkpoint SHA-256 and nonoverlapping path
n_updates, upstream n_grad_updates, optimizer step applications, outer cycles, and training transitions
complete PLR buffer and its static signature including tie-aware mode, Frontier N, and n_eval
all replay, tie, rejection, duplicate, and fill counters
terminal_checkpoint_contract.round_trip_failure_policy: invalidate the cell and every paired contrast that uses it before evaluation or endpoint access

evaluation.source: external minimax.evaluate terminal/checkpoint evaluation; in-training evaluations are secondary only
evaluation.primary_metric: unweighted mean of the three solved rates

estimands.identifiability: Delta_N isolates Frontier coefficient_activity versus MaxMC only within the shared N-specific layout. Cross-N contrasts combine changes in declared Frontier N, n_eval, n_parallel, and buffer_size and therefore cannot identify an estimator-N-only effect.

contrast_of_contrasts_interpretation.fixed_update: layout-conditioned effect modification; within each N/seed pair budgets must match exactly, but terminal cycles need not match across N
contrast_of_contrasts_interpretation.fixed_transition: all six cells must contribute aligned observations at the declared common transition boundary; interpretation remains joint-layout effect modification

required_descriptive_outputs: all five paired differences for every Delta_N
mean and two-sided paired Student-t 95% interval
two-sided exact paired sign-flip p value labeled descriptive
both predeclared contrast-of-contrasts by paired seed
tie sizes, score/replay effective support, and replay duplicate-draw telemetry

multiplicity_and_confirmatory_hold.final_confirmatory_sample_size: power and cost decision frozen before confirmatory endpoint access
multiplicity_and_confirmatory_hold.primary_family: Delta_2, Delta_4, Delta_8 with Holm control of family-wise alpha 0.05
multiplicity_and_confirmatory_hold.interaction_family: C_linear_log2N and C_curvature_log2N are secondary and require a separately frozen multiplicity rule
beat_claim_requires: a separately frozen direct matched ACCEL comparison
a strictly positive multiplicity-adjusted paired interval
all integrity, budget, and provenance gates

prerequisites_for_any_future_run: a separately hashed trainer that validates this exact protocol and all six config hashes
one frozen campaign manifest that binds the trainer, evaluator, assembler or finalizer, analyzer, scheduler script, source bundle, and complete environment provenance before endpoint access
the driver rejects parser-default xpid=latest and binds unique campaign/run/xpid/output/checkpoint identities before training
fresh v4 applied-source validation under the pinned CPU environment before any scheduler submission
new post-loop terminal checkpoint with no resume, no periodic-checkpoint substitution, and exact round-trip binding of cell identity, counters, N, n_eval, arm, config, protocol, and manifest
within each N/seed, exact equality of n_updates, upstream n_grad_updates, optimizer applications, outer cycles, transitions, and aligned fixed-transition observations
campaign manifest frozen before endpoint access
receipt support for observed fill trajectory, duplicate-new groups, transitions, tie diagnostics, and replay duplicate draws
